about: Project-owned contract (T008 A-01). docs/spec/contracts stays unchanged; tools/project_contract.py applies these amendments to its schemas and request bodies, and adds the new operations (operations) and schemas (new_schemas), refusing a path, operationId or schema name the contract already has. Unnamed schemas are the spec's. Consumers (apps/api tests, apps/web/src/api.ts guards) enforce the rule below; a null receipt or qualification never makes a proposal actionable.
changes: 0.2.0: fields no store holds yet become nullable (account, account_snapshot, proposal); snapshot gains ledger_cash (trade-date journal cash, not available cash) and coverage; pages gain the C-02 coverage; the active-proposal rule accepts a null final-check receipt or qualification. 0.3.0: claim and evidence gain coverage (withheld text, invalid citations and limitations are named there); claim material becomes nullable (no store records materiality). 0.4.0: proposal gains coverage (readProposal returns one proposal, so its nulls are named on the item; list items carry it too); ledger_event lot_policy_id becomes nullable (the journal stores a lot-policy name such as economic_average_cost/1, which is not a contract id; it is served in economic_annotations). 0.5.0: the request WatchlistEntry (addWatchlistEntry, updateWatchlistEntry) gains an optional, nullable review_at (RFC 3339 with an offset, normalized to UTC; on update, omitting it keeps the stored value); needs stays server-derived and is refused in requests. If-Match on every route: a stale or malformed value is 412 Precondition Failed and a required but missing one is 428 Precondition Required; this replaces the 409 that the OpenAPI If-Match descriptions name. 0.6.0: experiment gains coverage (readExperiment serves an incomplete or blocked record with its reasons instead of refusing it; list items carry it too); parent_optimizer_version is a string exactly when target is recursive_optimizer and null otherwise, named none:parent_optimizer_version; state gains blocked and insufficient_evidence (insufficient evidence is re-assessable while the plan's one holdout read is unused, checked against the ledger the assessor is given; failed is no longer derived for it). 0.7.0: GET /session (readSession) is documented exactly as T010 serves it; readApprovalClasses (GET /session/approval-classes) serves the caller's three approval classes, advisory only and never a grant: every action re-derives its own checks, no token or receipt is issued and no identity is served. Both are Cache-Control: no-store (the API sends no-store on every response). 0.8.0: the sessionCookie scheme's cookie name is __Host-pi_session (security_schemes; the __Host- prefix makes browsers require Secure and Path=/ and refuse a Domain). listMemberships (GET /memberships) is documented exactly as T010 serves it: any member reads the session tenant's memberships by user id, a C-02 page of at most 200 with an opaque, HMAC-bound cursor that expires after an hour. mutations is the owner-approved allowlist for amended mutating operations; it is empty, so login, logout, step-up and role change stay undocumented until each entry is approved. 0.9.0: createSession (POST /session, login), revokeSession (DELETE /session, logout), stepUpSession (POST /session/step-up) and changeMembershipRole (PATCH /memberships/{user_id}) are documented exactly as T010 serves them, each with a mutations entry citing decision 24. Login is unauthenticated (security []; no CSRF token or Idempotency-Key exists before a session) and logout is 204 with no body, through the unauthenticated_login and no_content exemptions on those two entries only (decision 25). The role change returns the stored display_name, so it reuses the list's Membership item (decision 26). 0.10.0: listPolicies (GET /policies, T019, T008 C-18) is documented exactly as served (decision 27): any member reads the session tenant's policies by policy id, a C-02 page of at most 100 whose items are the spec's policy schema, exactly readPolicy's body (status paused while a pause is active), with the T010 HMAC-bound cursor that expires after an hour. GET is added to the spec's /policies path, which keeps its POST proposePolicy unchanged. 0.11.0: experiment gains retest_of, the id of the same tenant's experiment this one re-tests (owner decision 19), or null, named none:retest_of. It is the frozen protocol's link, copied into each revision (immutable between revisions; the database holds the copy equal to the protocol's). qw_app still reads no assessor table. 0.12.0: listReleases (GET /releases, Read B; owner decision 45) serves the releases installed in the server's own recorded deployment, sorted by (installed_at, id), optionally one component, to members of a tenant in that deployment; no recorded deployment and a non-member are the same 404. Each release is verified at read time against the operator's stored trusted keys (signature.verification, reasons such as key_not_valid after a revocation), and its install state, runnability, self_approved (decision 23) and verdict_source (decision 33) are served. Receipts are not stored: receipt_status is unavailable, named unavailable:receipts. approved_at is null until receipts are stored, named unavailable:receipts too (decision 58 of 2026-10-23). Tenant members see no identity or installation-scope id (decision 10): experiment_id, candidate_id and verdict_id are null, named unavailable:<field>; the signature's key_id is null, named none:signature/key_id; signature_reference is sig-sha256. and 32 hex digits of the signature's SHA-256, carrying no key id (decision 55 of 2026-10-23). A stored row that fails a check is 409 integrity. readRelease and listDeploymentEvents are not served yet.
rule: A null in an amended field must be named in the response coverage.reasons as unavailable:<field>, unavailable:<id>/<field>, unknown:<field>, none:<field> or none:<id>/<field>. Item coverage reasons are <kind>:<detail>; page reasons are <kind>:<id>/<detail>.

ledger_cash.description: Trade-date journal cash per currency; not available cash.

get.description: Any member (tenant_member or tenant_owner) reads the latest version of each policy of the session's tenant, ordered by policy id (T019, T008 C-18). Each item is exactly readPolicy's body; its status is paused while the policy has an active pause. The tenant is derived from the session. The cursor is opaque, bound to tenant, principal, route and sort order by the server key, and expires after an hour; an invalid, foreign or expired cursor is 400 invalid_cursor. A stored record that fails verification is a 500 internal_error, a crash and never a client answer. Nothing is written except the authentication bookkeeping every authenticated request records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Server-bounded page size; tenant derived from session.

default.description: Typed validation, authorization, conflict, capacity or dependency failure; never a synthetic success. 401 unauthenticated without a valid session; 400 invalid_request or invalid_cursor; 500 internal_error when a stored record fails verification.

post.description: Verifies the caller's password again and records step_up_at on the session (T010); owner actions accept it for the step-up window (10 minutes by default). Throttled per address, then per account (429 too_many_attempts with Retry-After). The idempotency payload binds the session but not the password: a same-key retry on the same session replays the recorded step_up_at without verifying again.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: C-03: a same-key retry with the same payload replays the stored response; another payload, session or principal is 409 idempotency_key_reused; a malformed key is 400 invalid_idempotency_key.

parameters.name: X-CSRF-Token
parameters.description: The session's csrf_token (readSession); missing or wrong is 403 csrf_failed.

default.description: Typed validation, authorization, conflict, capacity or dependency failure; never a synthetic success. 403 reauthentication_failed, 401 unauthenticated, 403 csrf_failed or origin_rejected, 409 idempotency_key_reused, 429 too_many_attempts, 400 invalid_request or invalid_idempotency_key.

patch.description: Requires the tenant_owner role and a step-up within the window (401 step_up_required). The owners are locked, a demoted actor is 403 forbidden, promoting oneself is 403 self_promotion and removing the last owner is 409 last_owner. A foreign or unknown user_id is the same 404 not_found. Audited with the session actor. The response is the stored membership, the list's item (decision 26), with ETag "N".

post.description: Unauthenticated (decision 25, unauthenticated_login): no session, CSRF token or Idempotency-Key exists before login; the Origin/Referer allowlist still applies. The per-address, then per-account, throttle runs first (429 too_many_attempts with Retry-After). A wrong password and an unknown login get the same 401 invalid_credentials. The new session token is only in the Set-Cookie __Host-pi_session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, no Domain); the body is the readSession view.

get.summary: List the releases installed in this server's deployment
get.description: Read B (owner decision 45). Any member (tenant_member or tenant_owner) of a tenant listed in the server's operator-recorded deployment reads its installed releases, ordered by (install.installed_at, id), optionally only one component. Without a recorded deployment, or for a tenant that is not a member, the answer is 404 not_found. Every row is re-hashed and the ledger replayed with full signature checks against the stored trusted keys at the database clock; a stored row that fails a check is 409 integrity. The cursor is opaque, bound to tenant, principal, route, sort order and component by the server key, and expires after an hour; an invalid, foreign or expired cursor is 400 invalid_cursor. Nothing is written except the authentication bookkeeping every authenticated request records.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Server-bounded page size; tenant derived from session.

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: Only this component (<target>:<strategy id or target>).

default.description: Typed validation, authorization, conflict, capacity or dependency failure; never a synthetic success. 401 unauthenticated without a valid session; 400 invalid_request or invalid_cursor; 404 not_found without a recorded deployment or for a non-member; 409 integrity.

policyPage.title: Policy page
policyPage.description: C-02 page of the session tenant's policies by policy id; each item is the spec's policy schema, exactly readPolicy's body. next_cursor is null on the last page.

membershipPage.title: Membership page
membershipPage.description: C-02 page of the session tenant's memberships by user_id. next_cursor is null on the last page. display_name is the user's stored display name (1 to 200 characters). version is the membership's If-Match version.

approval_classes.title: Approval classes
approval_classes.description: Reasons: role_not_assigned (the session role does not carry the class), role_not_served (no role table, assignment or session field exists for the class), self_hosted_release_not_configured (a self-hosted installation holds maintainer_release only when explicitly configured to; no such configuration exists), step_up_required (no step-up within the window), operation_not_served (no operation of the class is served). held true never means an action will succeed.

releasePage.title: Release page
releasePage.description: C-02 page of the releases installed in the server's deployment (Read B, owner decision 45). signature.verification is verify_release at the read time against the operator's stored trusted keys (verified exactly when reasons is empty); install.runnable is DeploymentLedger.runnable at the read time (true exactly when reasons is empty); install.state is withdrawn after a rollback from it, paused after a pause of it, head while it is its component's current release, else installed. receipt_status is unavailable: no receipt is stored yet. approved_at (owner decision 58) is the maintainer approval time, null and named unavailable:receipts until receipts are stored. tenant_adoption is the caller's own tenant's state for a strategy release and null otherwise. Fields a tenant member may not see are null and named in coverage. next_cursor is null on the last page.

signature_reference.description: Owner decision 55: sig-sha256. followed by the first 32 lowercase hex digits of SHA-256 over the JSON string encoding of the signature value. It is computed from the signature alone, so it names no key and the key id cannot be recovered from it; equal values mean the same signature.
